    static class CompatFiller {
        public static void Fill(CompatInput[] values, System.Random random) {
            for (var index = 0; index < values.Length; index++) {
                values[index] = (index % 4) switch {
                    0 => CompatInput.Empty(),
                    1 => CompatInput.Position(random.NextSingle(), random.NextSingle()),
                    2 => CompatInput.Label("bench"),
                    3 => CompatInput.Batch(random.Next(), random.NextDouble()),
                    _ => CompatInput.Empty(),
                };
            }
        }
